title: Builder Incentive Coordination Memo: Calloway's Part of the Builder Extended Rate Lock Upfront Fee
content:
Where the buyer's purchase carries a rate buydown credit from the builder, Calloway bears part of the Builder Extended Rate Lock upfront fee, and the buyer pays only the buyer's fee share.

**Allocation.** Calloway's part is half the rate buydown credit granted on the agreement divided by the floored fee, the floored fee being the upfront lock fee after its minimum has been applied. Where the buyer's Home Purchase Agreement ledger carries both a closing cost credit and a rate buydown credit incentive granted on the agreement, the buyer's fee share is one less Calloway's part, Calloway's part never above 0.6; where it carries a rate buydown credit and no closing cost credit, the buyer's fee share is one less Calloway's part, Calloway's part never above 0.25; otherwise the buyer's fee share is one and the buyer pays the floored fee in full. The fee due from the buyer is the floored fee multiplied by the buyer's fee share, rounded half up to the cent.

## Branches

| Incentives granted on the agreement | Calloway's part | Buyer's fee share |
|---|---|---|
| closing cost credit and rate buydown credit | half the rate buydown credit divided by the floored fee, at most 0.6 | one less Calloway's part |
| rate buydown credit, no closing cost credit | half the rate buydown credit divided by the floored fee, at most 0.25 | one less Calloway's part |
| no rate buydown credit | none | one |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Floored fee USD 4000.00; rate buydown credit granted USD 3000.00; half is 1500.00, divided by 4000.00 gives 0.375.

- With a closing cost credit also granted: 0.375 is within 0.6; share 0.625; fee due USD 2500.00.
- With no closing cost credit: Calloway's part is held to 0.25; share 0.75; fee due USD 3000.00.
- With a rate buydown credit of USD 6000.00 and a closing cost credit: half is 3000.00, divided by 4000.00 gives 0.75, held to 0.6; share 0.4; fee due USD 1600.00.

The incentives are read from the Home Purchase Agreement ledger of the agreement the lock finances.
